title: Successor stage bound
statement: For every sequence $N$ of finite oracle Turing machines and every $i\in\mathbb{N}$, the bound at stage $i+1$ is the maximum of the fresh length chosen from $i$ and the bound at stage $i$, and the $i$th power of that stage bound plus $i$.
hypotheses_covered: A sequence $N$ of finite oracle Turing machines
